name: node-alias-fallback-break-minify-webpack-plugin
hook: .node$ resolve.alias and resolve.fallback.node=false break minify-webpack-plugin in Next.js 15.5.9
body: webpackConfig.resolve.alias for \.node$ files combined with resolve.fallback.node=false causes 'WebpackError is not a constructor' error in minify-webpack-plugin. This was explicitly removed in commit b2ae8ce94 ('remove .node$ alias and resolve.fallback that broke minify') but was re-added in 4930aa79b causing the build to fail again. These settings must NOT be added to the webpack config.
why: minify-webpack-plugin's buildError function tries to construct new webpack.WebpackError. When resolve.fallback.node=false is set, webpack's handling of node: URL schemes is disrupted in a way that corrupts the webpack module graph, causing WebpackError to not be a proper constructor.

name: serverexternalpackages-sufficient-for-undici-nextjs-15
hook: serverExternalPackages alone is sufficient for undici in Next.js 15.5.9 — webpack externals not needed
body: The isClient-guarded webpack externals for undici/@napi-rs/canvas were not the fix and added complexity. The undici package is already in serverExternalPackages which prevents it from being included in the serverless bundle. The original UnhandledSchemeError was likely a transient build issue, not a structural problem requiring webpack config changes. Keep the webpack config simple and matching dev.
why: serverExternalPackages handles Next.js-level bundling exclusion; webpack externals are a separate mechanism that should not be needed for undici if serverExternalPackages is configured.
